answer: Cross-epoch action replay checks. Each identity commits a salted hash of its epoch actions; next epoch a verifier samples categories and value bands and requires matching actions, ignoring timing and peers. The onyx salt binds commitments to that identity. A velvet audit opens only sampled records. To sustain N sybils, an attacker must run N coherent histories across epochs; copied or batched behavior fails, costing distinct execution and storage per identity. Basalt ledger anchors each epoch’s commitments.
